code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        marks = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
        if len(marks) >= 2:
            color = row[marks[0]] + 1
            for c in range(marks[0] + 1, marks[-1]):
                if row[c] == bg and (c-marks[0]) % 2 == 1:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
